parameters.content:
## Synchro promotions_dji
Source : template **actif** du back-office (`action=template`).

**Declencheurs**
- Webhook : appele par le module a chaque upload / restauration du template (URL de production a coller dans Module > Configuration API).
- Cron 5h : filet de securite si le webhook a echoue.
- Manuel : tests.

**UPSERT, jamais de TRUNCATE** : une promo retiree du template reste en base pour les declarations tardives. Cle = (reference_article, date_debut, date_fin), index `uq_promo_ref_dates` (scripts-sql/08).

Si le template est illisible ou vide, le Code echoue AVANT toute ecriture.

parameters.query:
WITH src AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
        statut                  text,
        type_promotion          text,
        produit                 text,
        ean                     text,
        reference_article       text,
        date_debut              date,
        date_fin                date,
        prix_vente_ttc          numeric,
        nouveau_prix_ttc        numeric,
        difference              numeric,
        compensation_ht         numeric,
        date_butoir_declaration date,
        mise_a_jour             date,
        declaration_sts_dji     text
    )
),
up AS (
    INSERT INTO public.promotions_dji AS p (
        statut, type_promotion, produit, ean, reference_article,
        date_debut, date_fin, prix_vente_ttc, nouveau_prix_ttc, difference,
        compensation_ht, date_butoir_declaration, mise_a_jour, declaration_sts_dji
    )
    SELECT
        statut, type_promotion, produit, ean, reference_article,
        date_debut, date_fin, prix_vente_ttc, nouveau_prix_ttc, difference,
        compensation_ht, date_butoir_declaration, mise_a_jour, declaration_sts_dji
    FROM src
    -- Doit correspondre a l'index uq_promo_ref_dates (scripts-sql/08).
    ON CONFLICT (reference_article, date_debut, (COALESCE(date_fin, '9999-12-31'::date)))
    DO UPDATE SET
        statut                  = EXCLUDED.statut,
        type_promotion          = EXCLUDED.type_promotion,
        produit                 = EXCLUDED.produit,
        ean                     = EXCLUDED.ean,
        prix_vente_ttc          = EXCLUDED.prix_vente_ttc,
        nouveau_prix_ttc        = EXCLUDED.nouveau_prix_ttc,
        difference              = EXCLUDED.difference,
        compensation_ht         = EXCLUDED.compensation_ht,
        date_butoir_declaration = EXCLUDED.date_butoir_declaration,
        mise_a_jour             = EXCLUDED.mise_a_jour,
        declaration_sts_dji     = EXCLUDED.declaration_sts_dji,
        updated_at              = NOW()
    -- Une ligne identique n'est pas reecrite : updated_at garde la date du
    -- dernier vrai changement.
    WHERE (p.statut, p.type_promotion, p.produit, p.ean, p.prix_vente_ttc,
           p.nouveau_prix_ttc, p.difference, p.compensation_ht,
           p.date_butoir_declaration, p.mise_a_jour, p.declaration_sts_dji)
          IS DISTINCT FROM
          (EXCLUDED.statut, EXCLUDED.type_promotion, EXCLUDED.produit, EXCLUDED.ean,
           EXCLUDED.prix_vente_ttc, EXCLUDED.nouveau_prix_ttc, EXCLUDED.difference,
           EXCLUDED.compensation_ht, EXCLUDED.date_butoir_declaration,
           EXCLUDED.mise_a_jour, EXCLUDED.declaration_sts_dji)
    RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inseree
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM src)                     AS lignes_envoyees,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE inseree)                AS inserees,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT inseree)            AS mises_a_jour,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM src) - count(*)          AS inchangees
FROM up;
